paragraphs.text: Community plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a lighter LLM service with self-contained provider profiles,
a declared model catalog, and the chat-completions, Anthropic Messages, and OpenAI Responses wires.
Not an official DeepSeek package.
# @snnh/dsh-llm-service-lite
English | 中文

> **Community plugin.** Maintained by snnh. It is not
> an official DeepSeek package: DeepSeek neith

er publishes nor supports it, and
> issues belong in this repository.
### Compatibility

This package drives the public seam of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` and the
`@deepseek-ai/cordis` service

layer, so it runs against a published harness
rather than a checkout: its peers are the harness pack

ages, and the profile
that loads it already owns the copies the runtime uses. The development
baseli

ne is harness `0.2.1-rc.2` — `devDependencies` pin those packages and the
test suite runs against th

em — while the `^0.2.1-alpha.2` peer ranges also admit
the `0.2.1` alpha line, so an older `0.2.1` h
arness loads the same package.

Two declarations of the archived dsh-lite
fork are used when the running harness carries them and sk

ipped when it does
not: the model-defaults registration seam a configuration surface asks for
declar

ed model ids, and the `outputModalities` field on a model's info. Upstream
`0.2.1-rc.2` carries neit

her, so both are inert there: the adapter keeps its
family defaults on the request path, where they

still fill the fields a profile
left open, and the extra field is simply ignored by the runtime.
### Declare what a model can do
A model entry's `capabilities` are declarations about the endpoint, never guesses: a capability left
out is one this adapter does not claim, and one it declares is honoured or refused by name — never
accepted with nothing behind it. `effort` lists the selectable reasoning levels and its values are t
he wire spellings, so a gateway with its own vocabulary declares that vocabulary. `thinking` lists t
he accepted thinking modes (`enabled`, `disabled`, `adaptive`). `thinkingStyle` says how the endpoin
t spells the switch: `thinking: { type: … }`, a top-level `enable_thinking` boolean, `fixed` for a m
odel that always thinks, or `effort_only` — the explicit spelling of an endpoint that takes an effor
t level and has no switch, which is the same request an omitted style sends. `reasoningContent` decl
ares that the endpoint returns reasoning in `reasoning_content`, which is what lets a later request
replay prior thinking. `replayReasoning` decides whether that prior thinking actually travels back:
absent defers to the model's family (see below), `true` sends it, and a family whose follow-up turns
are rejected without it refuses to be turned off. `tools` declares whether tool declarations may be
jected without it refuses to be turned off. `tools` declares whether tool declarations may be [长行截断]
**Family defaults.** A hand-written profile states what its author knows and leaves the rest to the
model's family: `src/model-defaults.ts` is a reviewed table of what the mainstream families document
— the image input a vision model takes, the effort ladder and the level its own platform applies by
default, the switch spelling, and whether prior reasoning must travel back. The table only fills wh
at the profile left open, so a profile field always wins; a family that shows no entry for a model l
eaves the adapter's own conservative answer in place; and nothing in it defaults a sampling paramete
r, because vendors disagree about the reachable ranges and the endpoint's own default beats an inven
ted one. Each entry records the vendor documentation it came from, and only the model owner's own pl
atform is ever a source: what a reseller or gateway requires of the same model id is not.
[该节后续省略]
#### What the model sees
The conversation exactly as the harness assembled it: the system prompt as a leading system message,
user and assistant turns in order, tool declarations as function schemas, and each tool result atta
ched to the call it answers. A request adds the endpoint's own `extraBody` fields and, when the mode
l declares how it spells them, the effort level and thinking switch the caller selected.
## Known Limitations and Deferred Work
- **Three protocols, three shapes.** Every declared protocol has a transport, and each carries that
protocol's own features: the Responses API's server-side tools (`web_search_call` items) are not car
ried, and no `store` field is sent, so a deployment keeps provider-side state out of the request pat

h.
- **Configuration lives on the Models page seats, the plugin page, or in the patch.** The plugin
fills the Models page's adapter-family extension seats and the bundle's page under **Plugins**; the
profile's `cordis.patch.yml` remains the surface for hand-written fields the editors do not render (

see Mount).
- **Video input arrives as a file, not as moving pictures.** A declared `video` input is
carried as the file handle every attachment contributes, because no wire here has a video part and
the harness has no video content block yet. `image` input is carried, and so is the token accounting
a profile declares through `imageTokens`; a route that declares none keeps the meter's structural h
euristic, and no adapter-authored handle text travels beside the bytes, so a priced occurrence count

s the visual tokens the endpoint charges and nothing this adapter invented.
- **No adapter-side retr
ies.** One call is one provider attempt, so the provider's retry policy is executed by `dsh-llm-retr

y` at the durable step boundary, and a retry re-derives the whole request.
- **Replay metadata is pr
otocol-specific.** The Messages transport writes and reads its own envelope for thinking signatures,
and the Responses transport keeps each reasoning item (id and encrypted payload) for the model that

asked for encrypted replay; neither envelope is portable across providers.
- **Mid-history changes
are the endpoint's own contract.** A route that declared `systemPromptUpdate` or `toolUpdate` receiv
es them as `system`-role history messages, so an endpoint that gates that part behind a beta header
is configured with that header in `headers`: nothing is injected on the endpoint's behalf, and a cha
nge that arrives with no user turn to follow fails the request with `UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT` instead of

being silently moved or dropped.
[该节后续省略]
